sentences.hanzi: 国庆假期，小明和丽丽陪爷爷去公园看花展。
sentences.pinyin: Guóqìng jiàqī, Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì péi yéye qù gōngyuán kàn huāzhǎn.
sentences.english: During the National Day holiday, Xiaoming and Lili accompanied Grandpa to the park to see a flower exhibition.

sentences.hanzi: 公园里有很多美丽的花，特别是菊花，颜色多极了。
sentences.pinyin: Gōngyuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō měilì de huā, tèbié shì júhuā, yánsè duō jí le.
sentences.english: There were many beautiful flowers in the park, especially chrysanthemums, with a great variety of colors.

sentences.hanzi: 有红的、黄的、白的，还有紫色的菊花，真好看。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu hóng de, huáng de, bái de, hái yǒu zǐsè de júhuā, zhēn hǎokàn.
sentences.english: There were red, yellow, white, and also purple chrysanthemums. They were really beautiful.

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷笑着说：“这些菊花真漂亮，我要多拍几张照片。”
sentences.pinyin: Yéye xiào zhe shuō: "Zhèxiē júhuā zhēn piàoliang, wǒ yào duō pāi jǐ zhāng zhàopiàn."
sentences.english: Grandpa said with a smile, "These chrysanthemums are so beautiful. I want to take a few more photos."

sentences.hanzi: 小明拿出手机，对丽丽说：“我来给爷爷和菊花一起拍张照吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng ná chū shǒujī, duì Lìlì shuō: "Wǒ lái gěi yéye hé júhuā yīqǐ pāi zhāng zhào ba."
sentences.english: Xiaoming took out his phone and said to Lili, "Let me take a photo of Grandpa together with the chrysanthemums."

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽说：“好啊，我也要用手机拍一些花的照片。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: "Hǎo a, wǒ yě yào yòng shǒujī pāi yīxiē huā de zhàopiàn."
sentences.english: Lili said, "Sure! I also want to use my phone to take some photos of the flowers."

sentences.hanzi: 他们三个人在公园里走走停停，看到了很多不同样子的菊花。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen sān gè rén zài gōngyuán lǐ zǒuzǒu tíngtíng, kàn dào le hěn duō bùtóng yàngzi de júhuā.
sentences.english: The three of them walked and paused here and there in the park, seeing many chrysanthemums of different shapes.

sentences.hanzi: 有的菊花很大，像一个小球；有的菊花很小，但是非常多。
sentences.pinyin: Yǒu de júhuā hěn dà, xiàng yī gè xiǎo qiú; yǒu de júhuā hěn xiǎo, dànshì fēicháng duō.
sentences.english: Some chrysanthemums were very big, like a small ball; some were very small, but there were very many of them.

sentences.hanzi: 小明对丽丽说：“你看，这些花真特别，我想把它们都拍下来。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng duì Lìlì shuō: "Nǐ kàn, zhèxiē huā zhēn tèbié, wǒ xiǎng bǎ tāmen dōu pāi xiàlái."
sentences.english: Xiaoming said to Lili, "Look, these flowers are really special. I want to photograph them all."

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽说：“是呀，我们多拍一些，回家以后可以慢慢看。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: "Shì ya, wǒmen duō pāi yīxiē, huíjiā yǐhòu kěyǐ mànmàn kàn."
sentences.english: Lili said, "Yes. Let's take more photos so we can look at them slowly after we get home."

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷听了很高兴，他说：“你们真孝顺，今天爷爷很开心。”
sentences.pinyin: Yéye tīng le hěn gāoxìng, tā shuō: "Nǐmen zhēn xiàoshùn, jīntiān yéye hěn kāixīn."
sentences.english: Grandpa was very happy to hear this. He said, "You are so filial. Grandpa is very happy today."

sentences.hanzi: 回家的路上，他们一起讨论怎样把这些照片做成一本家庭相册。
sentences.pinyin: Huíjiā de lùshang, tāmen yīqǐ tǎolùn zěnyàng bǎ zhèxiē zhàopiàn zuò chéng yī běn jiātíng xiàngcè.
sentences.english: On the way home, they discussed together how to make these photos into a family album.

sentences.hanzi: 小明说：“丽丽，你觉得我们应该选哪些照片放进相册里呢？”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shuō: "Lìlì, nǐ juéde wǒmen yīnggāi xuǎn nǎxiē zhàopiàn fàng jìn xiàngcè lǐ ne?"
sentences.english: Xiaoming said, "Lili, which photos do you think we should choose to put in the album?"

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽回答：“我觉得先选爷爷和菊花的合照，再选一些最美的菊花照片。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì huídá: "Wǒ juéde xiān xuǎn yéye hé júhuā de hézhào, zài xuǎn yīxiē zuì měi de júhuā zhàopiàn."
sentences.english: Lili answered, "I think we should first choose the photos of Grandpa with the chrysanthemums, and then choose some of the most beautiful chrysanthemum photos."

sentences.hanzi: 小明说：“这个主意不错，我们还可以在每张照片下面写一句话。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shuō: "Zhège zhǔyi bùcuò, wǒmen hái kěyǐ zài měi zhāng zhàopiàn xiàmiàn xiě yī jù huà."
sentences.english: Xiaoming said, "That's a good idea. We can also write a sentence under each photo."

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽笑着说：“对，比如写上‘国庆节和爷爷看花展’，这样以后看相册就知道是哪一天了。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì xiào zhe shuō: "Duì, bǐrú xiě shàng 'Guóqìngjié hé yéye kàn huāzhǎn', zhèyàng yǐhòu kàn xiàngcè jiù zhīdào shì nǎ yī tiān le."
sentences.english: Lili said with a smile, "Right. For example, we could write 'National Day holiday, seeing the flower exhibition with Grandpa.' That way, when we look at the album later, we will know which day it was."

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷点点头说：“你们想得真周到，这本相册一定会很珍贵。”
sentences.pinyin: Yéye diǎndiǎn tóu shuō: "Nǐmen xiǎng de zhēn zhōudào, zhè běn xiàngcè yīdìng huì hěn zhēnguì."
sentences.english: Grandpa nodded and said, "You have thought it through so carefully. This album will definitely be very precious."

sentences.hanzi: 他们商量好了，回到家以后，先整理照片，再一起做相册。
sentences.pinyin: Tāmen shāngliáng hǎo le, huí dào jiā yǐhòu, xiān zhěnglǐ zhàopiàn, zài yīqǐ zuò xiàngcè.
sentences.english: After they finished discussing, they decided that once they got home, they would first organize the photos and then make the album together.

sentences.hanzi: 这个国庆假期，他们不仅看了美丽的花展，还留下了很多美好的回忆。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège Guóqìng jiàqī, tāmen bùjǐn kàn le měilì de huāzhǎn, hái liúxià le hěn duō měihǎo de huíyì.
sentences.english: During this National Day holiday, they not only saw a beautiful flower exhibition but also created many wonderful memories.
